title: Porous polylactic acid fibers synthesized by centrifugal spinning with phase separation for oil removal application
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,11749-11758
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08727E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kenji Kinashi, Masaki Negoro, Hoan Ngoc Doan, Phu Phong Vo, Khanh Van Thi Khuat, Wataru Sakai, Naoto Tsutsumi
This study presents porous, hydrophobic, and superoleophilic polylactic acid (PLA) fibers fabricated using centrifugal spinning and nonsolvent-induced phase separation. PLA fibers from a chloroform/dimethylformamide (80/20) solution showed excellent water repellence and oil absorption.
